events.verdict: Lowry (TOR) cleanly deflects the ball away from Fournier (ORL).
Lowry (TOR) makes incidental contact with Iwundu (ORL) as he dives on the floor, and the contact does not affect Iwundu's ability to retrieve the ball.
RAR shows Iwundu (ORL) slides his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Gordon (ORL) does not dislodge Ibaka (TOR) from his legally obtained screening position.
Gordon (ORL) engages with Leonard (TOR) but does not affect his ability to get to the pass.
Ibaka (TOR) is already in Gordon's (ORL) path when contact occurs and he does not deliver contact.
RLS shows Lowry (TOR) does not make contact to Fournier's (ORL) arm as he defends the shot attempt.
Ibaka (TOR) is already in Gordon's (ORL) path when contact occurs and he does not deliver contact.
Vucevic (ORL) legally contests Leonard's (TOR) jump shot attempt.
RAR and RLB show Ibaka (TOR) and Vucevic (ORL) make incidental contact with one another during rebounding.
Green (TOR) and Fournier (ORL) briefly engage and separate off ball.
Siakam (TOR) makes high-five contact with Gordon (ORL)'s hand after he has released the ball.
Leonard (TOR) and Vucevic (ORL) briefly engage and then separate.
Lowry (TOR) does not make contact to Vucevic's (ORL) head during rebounding.
Ibaka (TOR) is already in Fournier's (ORL) path when contact occurs and he does not deliver contact.
Fournier (ORL) briefly grasps Green's (TOR) jersey off ball, but does not affect his ability to defend.
Fournier (ORL) extends his leg as part of his natural shooting motion, any contact from Green (TOR) to Fournier's leg is considered incidental.
Ibaka (TOR) is in the paint for longer than three seconds.
Ibaka (TOR) is already in Fournier's (ORL) path when contact occurs, and he does not deliver contact.
Lowry (TOR) briefly brings an arm to Augustin's (ORL) side before correcting as they continue to move in the same direction during the inbound.
[Detectable with a stop watch] Gordon (ORL) does not inbound the ball within five seconds.

After the made dunk shot to tie the game 91-91, Fournier (ORL) remains on the rim after the timeout is called and players have cleared the area under the rim. The ball is dead and he is not taunting opponents or delaying the game and a technical foul is not called.
Ibaka (TOR) is already in Iwundu's (ORL) path when contact occurs and he does not deliver contact.
Gordon (ORL) legally contests Green's (TOR) jump shot attempt.
